basic_info.description: Welcome to 4187 26th Street, a one-of-a-kind urban sanctuary where Edwardian original detail meets Zen tranquility! This top floor 2 bedroom condo in a 2-unit building with a flexible floorplan is a Noe Valley gem. Since the building was built in 1894, the condo offers a timeless blend of character and serenity. It has a renovated kitchen with abundant cabinetry, sleek stainless steel appliances and skylights flooding the space with natural light.   There is a spacious living room with a window overlooking the light-filled sunroom that is perfect for dining. An enchanting shared garden, a lush tropical oasis, is tucked away from the bustle of street traffic, creating a peaceful retreat. A washer/dryer is located conveniently on the exclusive deck and there is a sizable attic for storage.  This home, with its charming old-world allure, will become your personal haven - a place of renewal and peace. It is centrally located, close to public transportation, tech shuttles and a short walk to the cozy cafes, charming shops and the restaurants of 24th Street.
